correctness.rationale: Each latent Y_e is the indicator of a positive-mass descendant set S_e, which form a strict laminar family. Comparable edges have covariance q_desc(1−q_anc)>0 and disjoint edges have covariance −q_e q_f<0. Conditional independence across channels and positive slopes t_e−f_e>0 multiply each latent covariance by two positive slopes, preserving signs. The positive graph is exactly the transitive ancestor closure, a trivially perfect graph. Equal CLOSED neighborhoods correspond to consecutive unary edge runs (a branch between two edges would distinguish neighborhoods), and recursively deleting the unique universal true-twin class of each connected quotient component recovers the labelled contracted forest. Hoeffding for p+binom(p,2)≤p² empirical means, u=γ/4, gives P(error)≤2p² exp(−Nγ²/8). All strict-positivity, channel independence and p≥2 boundaries were checked; independent rational covariance calculation on a four-event rooted tree checked each of six event pairs, not all trees.
